query: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'work', to_jsonb(w), 'manifestation', to_jsonb(m), 'versions', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY v.id), '[]') FROM metadata_versions v WHERE v.manifestation_id = m.id), 'locks', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) ORDER BY l.entity_type, l.field_name), '[]') FROM field_locks l WHERE l.manifestation_id = m.id), 'jobs', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j) ORDER BY j.id), '[]') FROM writeback_jobs j WHERE j.manifestation_id = m.id) ) AS "state!" FROM manifestations m JOIN works w ON w.id = m.work_id WHERE m.id = $1
